svg.title: From training to physical operation
svg.desc: Finish and record the simulated exercise, review changed data, prepare the physical machine, select Normal and confirm connection, repeat real setup checks, then request the approved operation separately.

g.text: Returning to Normal is a new operating decision
A successful simulated exercise does not approve the physical setup.
1. Finish the exercise and record the outcome
2. Review files, references and settings changed
3. Prepare the physical machine for connection
4. Select Normal; confirm the actual connection
5. Complete real Home, tool and workpiece checks
is not the real stock datum.
Concept diagram. Follow the machine builder's startup and physical verification procedures.
